name: v2.6.5+26.3 ~ Datapack
changelog:
# Terralith v2.6.5+26.3
- Updated to support 26.3 (Apollo)
- Implemented new Poplar blocks into existing biomes
- Added Shelf Mushrooms to all fallen logs
- Added custom Abandoned Camps for Alpine Highlands (more later!)
- Vanilla Abandoned Camps generate in Terralith biomes
- Fixed a bug where features would not generate properly in Gravel Desert
- Fixed a bug where Scarlet Mountain had too much snow
- Fixed a bug where upgrading to new versions could result in small chunk borders

Huge thank you to Apollo for making the majority of this update happen.
